verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a built-in AI assistant in the Riskified console: no natural-language queries over fraud data, no drafted rules, and no investigation summaries. The Integration Console is an API-validation tool, and llms.txt is documentation formatted for LLMs; neither is an analyst-facing AI assistant. The axis applies to a fraud platform, so absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the product ships its own AI assistant — natural-language queries over my fraud data, drafted rules, investigation summaries — built into the console
